name: Thank God I'm a Country Boy

podcast.body: This song is mentioned as an example of John Denver's well-known country hits, providing context for his musical style when discussing his lawsuit against New Order. "And yeah, that John Denver, the country singer, they look like a muppet who sang songs like Thank God I'm a Country Boy."
